Instruction: The main difference is stronger sunshine and shadows, whereas the expected dog should open its mouth and extend its tongue. Its mouth remains closed, so heat dissipation is not depicted. Knowledge: The supplied explanation requires the tongue to stick out; no tongue is visible. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
